name: 1st Shenzhen Open Source Silicon Meetup
summary: The kickoff meetup of the SZOSS series: an afternoon of technical exchange, silicon demos and conversation with researchers, open-source contributors and Shenzhen's hardware community.
description:
First event of the SZOSS (Shenzhen Open Source Silicon) series, also known as 首届深圳开源芯片交流会.

Topics include open tools, PDKs and shared fabrication routes; connecting chip layouts to boards and working hardware; and research, education and collaboration across the open-silicon community.

The venue is small, so the group is kept small. Registration is required and attendees are asked to say what they are working on.

address.street: B622, Design Commune (万科云设计公社), Dashi 2nd Road, Nanshan District

source.note: Date, time, venue, organizer, registration and speakers are from the event page. Price (free) and language (en) are not stated on the page; they were confirmed by the organizer team. The street address is from https://wiki.hackerspaces.org/Chaihuo and is not on the event page.
